data.name: MEH2_001
data.value: Their little group makes a wonderful bunch,[pause=10] don't you think?[pause=0] I'm glad he's able to get along with them.

data.name: MEH2_002
data.value: If I go outside,[pause=10] I might get stuck doing nothing with the wonder twins again.

data.name: MEH3_001
data.value: Should any outlaws present themselves to me,[pause=10] I would easily defeat them myself.

data.name: MEH3_002
data.value: The other Pokémon in town should do the same,[pause=10] but they've become soft living close to the guild.

data.name: MEH4_001
data.value: I'm disappointed in him.[pause=0] He should be better,[pause=10] but his behavior and his fruitless results are no surprise to me.

data.name: MEH5_001
data.value: Too bad my husband isn’t part of your guild. You’ll struggle without someone strong like him around!

data.name: MEH5_002
data.value: Hmmph.[pause=0] Were I an adventurer,[pause=10] I would crush an exploration like that all by myself.

data.name: MEH5_003
data.value: And yet an entire guild of adventurers needs all hands on deck for such an effort?[pause=0] How pitiful.

data.name: MEH6_001
data.value: Three famous explorers, right here in Metano![pause=0] I do hope they stop by our street.

data.name: MEH6_002
data.value: Rulux says real explorers don't pose for the crowd.[pause=0] I think he's just a little jealous, honestly.

data.name: MEH6_003
data.value: Three "celebrities" and not one of them could handle a proper mountain pass, I'd wager.

data.name: MEH6_004
data.value: Camentra thinks they're wonderful.[pause=0] Camentra thinks everyone's wonderful. That's rather the problem.

data.name: MEH6_005
data.value: You saved that poor little one![pause=0] Rulux won't admit it, but he was worried the whole time too.

data.name: MEH6_006
data.value: ...Fine.[pause=0] That was decent work.[pause=0] Don't let it go to your heads.

data.name: MEH6_007
data.value: It's been a strange morning.[pause=0] Everyone in the street is talking about something happening at the guild.

data.name: MEH6_008
data.value: Whatever it is, it had better not interrupt my training schedule.
